issue.body:
Can rebuilding after historical resets restore correct-revision code without per-task repairs? Follow-up to #28, initially scoped to MACS; investigation remains open.

**Candidate evidence:** an opt-in hook replays recorded bootstrap commands after patch application in native validation and exported verification. Twelve compiled lifecycle checks, seven graded-export checks and six complete native-validator checks pass. The native check produces the expected F2P/P2P sets; pre/post build failures stop validation. Default-off outcomes and commands match upstream.

**Integration:** the complete patched upstream package loads configuration, constructs the registered pipeline, builds tasks and writes Harbor files for default/on/off settings. Missing rebuild commands and unknown options are rejected. No external calls occur in these checks. This is synthetic local evidence, not biological recovery or a full generation CLI/Docker/Harbor run; the dependency environment is recorded and is not upstream's full locked environment.

**Reconstruction result:** all 16 recorded MACS actions replayed unchanged. The original 300-second smoke check timed out; a separate arm changed only smoke/fresh limits to 1,200 seconds. Both checks then exited 0 in roughly seven minutes, each reporting 4,924 passed and 348 skipped. Payload and actual base image match across arms; installed dependencies may still drift. This establishes a usable reconstructed environment, not PR792 validity. [Timing evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/9c2071e6/experiments/31-historical-builds/macs-longcheck-diagnosis.json).

**Native comparison submitted:** PR792 original versus recorded-command rebuild, using separate fresh containers from the same reconstructed image. Original eight test targets, argv transport, parser and 600-second stage timeout remain fixed; only the opt-in rebuild intervention differs. Outcomes are pending. [Protocol](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/52f57a92/experiments/31-historical-builds/macs-native-protocol.md).

**Remaining and budget:** collect native outcomes, verify exported controls if recovery is claimed, then remove the retained image. Two terminal reconstruction attempts used 2.49975 allocated CPU-hours; the submitted comparison reserves at most 10 more under the 16-hour ceiling. Zero model calls or new capacity. Reconstruction archives are verified; comparison cleanup/readback remain pending. No production change promoted.

[Native outcomes](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6c03d407/experiments/31-historical-builds/native-outcome-results.json) · [Package integration](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6c03d407/experiments/31-historical-builds/package-integration-results.json) · [Frozen MACS case](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6c03d407/experiments/31-historical-builds/macs-case.json) · [Full scope](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/6c03d407/experiments/31-historical-builds/issue-scope.md). Detailed logs remain in comments.

comment.body:
🤖 Submitted the frozen MACS PR792 original-versus-rebuild comparison from checkpoint `52f57a92`. The driver invokes the actual pinned original and patched validators in separate 1.5-CPU/6-GiB containers from the same verified reconstructed image. Original eight test targets, parser, argv transport and 600-second stage timeout are unchanged. Rebuild commands retain their literal syntax; no dependency or task-specific repairs.

Before submission, four stage scripts regenerated exactly, default-off parity and source hashes verified, and four no-Docker fixtures checked failure/timeout/deadline/stage-integrity guards. The existing reserved image worker has headroom. One attempt is bounded to 9,000 seconds at 4 allocated CPUs/16 GiB, at most 10 CPU-hours; cumulative maximum is 12.49975 under 16. Zero model calls/new capacity. Outcomes, archive readback and cleanup remain pending.

[Driver and checks](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/tree/52f57a92/experiments/31-historical-builds). This is native validation; no new task exports or independent control success is claimed.
